name: Enterprise Microservices Platform
summary: Distributed services with clear business boundaries.
description: Architecture and delivery work on a distributed platform of ASP.NET Core APIs. The platform uses Domain-Driven Design and Vertical Slice Architecture to organise business capabilities and isolate responsibilities.
technologies: ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 / .NET 9, EF Core, SQL Server, Azure Service Bus, Docker, OpenAPI
challenge: Large application domains need service boundaries that support growth without tightly coupling every feature and integration.
approach: Organise services around business domains and vertical feature slices, using messaging for service communication and containerisation for delivery. Document API contracts through OpenAPI.
imageAlt: Conceptual workflow diagram showing service boundaries, owned SQL data, and Azure Service Bus
